modes._comment: #398-P3 review M9: no skill_property. An M-ARM mode's signature is (mechanism, skill-or-gate, prop); a made-up 'trapwork' label was labeling, not distinctness.

_comment_gallery: NORTH GALLERY x14-19 y0-2, sealed by these six + (13,0)/(13,1)/(16,3). Two ways in, neither a spell: [Rope Arrow] rigs the drop, [Greater Strength] shifts the slab. Rows 0-4 is the only quadrant no QA route walks; dungeon_peek's own pin comments carry the live counts.

segments._comment: #398-P3 review B1 SEAL: the y10 run left the east side open (x10 y12/13 walked straight in). BFS: gates closed reaches nothing in y11-13 x0-8; either mode alone reaches guard and cache.

floor_layers._pick: Cemetery-floor variation reusing the dungeon biome's own verified floor-tile neighborhood (2,2)/(3,7) plus the genuinely darker worn variant (2,11) for real wear texture.

decor._comment: Collapse dressing: the mouth reads as a fall-in, not built masonry.

entities._comment: Return leg of the new dungeon_approach<->trapped_halls door pair.

entities.observe: One flagstone sits a hair proud of its neighbors, the mortar cracked clean around its edge. Light does not reach the bottom of the crack.
entities.toast: The flagstone drops half an inch under your palm. A catch clicks somewhere back inside the wall, and nothing comes of it.

entities._comment: Own graph (ksmvr_plates.json): the guide option is the real beat, gated on `horns_party_formed` (the party must exist to guide). v0.15 T4.3 round 2: last of the six Horns presence rows to move onto horns_dig_started, so the halls stop holding a copy of Ksmvr while the camp holds one. Contract: inn.json's `ceria_inn_returned`.
entities._comment_dig: Retires PERMANENTLY at horns_dig_STARTED, the delve-staging split the approach map's Horns rows use -- dungeon_approach.json's `ceria` _comment_dig holds the contract and its v0.15 provenance (#398-P3 census trim). Safe either way: seal_kept_reported gates the dig invitation.

entities.skill_hint_toast: A narrow slit at knee height, the length of the wall; look properly first and there is a mechanism behind it to find.
entities.locked_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height. Whatever is loaded behind it, you have no idea how to disable it.
entities.item_hint_toast: A narrow slit at knee height, the mechanism seated behind the stone. Bare fingers will not reach the catch; this one takes a trap kit.

on_skill_use.toast: You follow the mechanism back to its catch and wedge it there with a wax-and-wire pick. The slit goes dark, and the kit is spent doing it.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The floor ahead looks exactly like the floor behind you. An eye trained to look properly would find the difference.
entities.locked_toast: The floor ahead looks perfectly ordinary. You do not have the eye to check.

on_skill_use.toast: You look properly and the floor ahead stops matching the floor behind: grain crossways, paint edge a finger short of the wall, months of dust everywhere but that patch.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Under your boot the stone hums off-key. Eyes that read mana could say what.
entities.locked_toast: The stone here looks like all the other stone. Without a reading for mana, that is as far as you get.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — The seam lights up like a badly kept secret: old wardwork, still holding, drawn tight around the floor ahead. Now you know exactly what not to trust.

entities.observe: A coil of taut wire lies strung ankle-height between two stones, near-invisible against the dust. The far end disappears into the dark.
entities.gate_closed_toast: You step wide around the wire. The dust past it is trodden into a track running both ways; leave the passage until the delve is under way.

entities._comment: Matches rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian/awakened_boss's own interact-only convention for a boss the player consciously commits to, not an environmental ambush.
entities.observe: The hall ends in a sealed archway. Past it the dark is filled nearly to the edges by the same shape you glimpsed crouched near the entrance, closer now and holding still. There is no dust on it.
entities.gate_closed_toast: The halls are still armed, and the Horns are not with you. Both have to change before you go through this arch.

entities._comment: FROZEN ID, dead fiction (spec 7 amendment 1): the display name was 'A Second Door'. The entity id is shipped and frozen; the fiction is not. This is a sealed rune-door full of wardwork by the hand that cut the inn's frame -- never a second Magical Door, never another portal. No QA script pins the old label.
entities.toast: The passage doesn't end here — it just goes quiet, past a bend the light doesn't reach. Whatever's back there, this isn't the moment.
entities._comment_reading: Act V beat 2, THE READING (#270). Three eyes on one door, the pantry-door consolidation idiom. LATER-SATISFIED-WINS across `variants` makes the bare interact a two-stage narration: with the descent agreed Pisces matches the hand (read_the_seal_runes), and his next read names the appetite (read_the_feeding_ward). That staging is load-bearing -- no main-line beat may sit behind a Skill the player's build might not own (spec 6) -- so the escort is the guaranteed producer of both reads. Pre-descent arms bank `sensed_something_deeper`, never the real reads, which ORDER-GATES the quest: nothing in Act V can bank from a curious Act IV visit.

variants.toast: The runes are the same. The same hand, the same order, as the door in the inn's pantry.
Pisces reaches the door before you do and stops a handspan short of it. "The same hand. One person's work, and this door was the first of it." He does not look away while he says it.

Pisces steps back at last. "The lines run one way. They have run one way for a very long time, and something on the far side has been drinking the whole while. Your inn has a frame by this hand. Sleep well."
The runes keep their slow one-way order. Pisces has stopped narrating and started counting under his breath, which is worse.

observe.toast: [Observe] — Tool marks in every line of it from top to bottom, and not one of them reads as a lock or says what the door is for.

variants.toast: [Observe] — You take the runes in order, the way you would read a sentence. The turns repeat at a fixed interval. The pantry frame does exactly that, at exactly that interval, and this one is worn deeper: it has been doing it longer. Behind you, Pisces says nothing.

detect_magic.toast: [Detect Magic] — Wardwork, and awake: it does not flare and settle the way a bound ward should. It holds one low steady note, like a breath nobody has to let out, and you have felt that note somewhere else.

variants.toast: [Detect Magic] — The ward opens under your sight and does not stop opening. It is not holding anything shut. It is POURING: one direction, one slow measured rate, into whatever the stone is between. It has poured since before the city. Pisces, very quietly: "Ah. So that is what the others were."

[Detect Magic] — Every reading you have taken lines up at once: the inn's frame, the ruin's socket, the seam back down the hall, the hollow west of Riverfarm. Not four wards. One lattice, and this door is where it drains to. Something behind this stone has been drinking Liscor's oldest work since before Liscor. Pisces uses a word you have never heard him use in public.

entities._comment_door: Act V beat 3, the FIGHT path. door_when is checked BEFORE the interact arm (interactions.gd prop branch order), so once seal_opened banks this stops being a thing to read and becomes a way through. seal_opened banks ONLY on Pisces' open-it fork, so the TALK and SKILL paths leave this door shut forever, as #270 requires.

door_when.open_toast: The seal does not resist. It simply stops being a seal — the runes go quiet in order, one ring at a time, and the door swings in on three centuries of undisturbed air.

entities._comment: Act V: THE SEAL'S WARDEN. present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters, so it stands here from first arrival, VISIBLE AND INERT (the rift_vermin_leak pattern) with its own observe + gate_closed_toast. encounter_when arms it on seal_opened alone, which only the FIGHT fork banks. trigger_radius 1 makes it UNSKIPPABLE on that fork -- (18,7) is the only walkable approach to the door and sits one cell off; a sneaking player still slips by and banks sneaked_past_danger. CELL (19,6) is reachable only from (19,5), so it blocks no route, and it is NOT (18,7), which delve_fight stands on. Roster: `seal_warden`, a distinct id per combatants.json:401.
entities._comment_victory: on_victory is the ENGINE DEFAULT spelled out (test_combat_data requires the key on every encounter): the warden banks no story counter. Act V's resolution belongs to the room behind it -- vault_anchor_stone's open banks seal_resolved -- so sneaking past and flattening it reach the same beat at different cost.
entities.gate_closed_toast: Dust lies over it in one unbroken sheet centuries thick; leave it where it is.
entities.observe: An alcove beside the sealed door, and standing in it a shoulder-high ward-stone cut in the hand that cut the runes. Seams cross its shoulders and knees, and no statue in this dungeon has those.
entities._comment_loot: DELIBERATELY no `loot` array: every enchanted accessory this fight could plausibly drop (warded_coil_charm, construct_core_shard, guardian_ward_fragment) is a chance-1.0 drop from a fight the player must already have won to be standing here, and `pickup` no-ops a duplicate id. The reward is the room behind it (seal_anchor_rune) plus the quest's resolution_paths grant.

entities._comment: Act V: THE ESCORT. Pisces is the voice at this door -- the prop never speaks (Global Constraint), so everything that needs OPTIONS lives here. present_when brackets from the descent ask onward and never closes: a vanished escort would read as a bug. CELL (19,8) is deliberately NOT (18,7), delve_fight's own standing cell for the seal_kept_found beat -- an entity there would strand a shipped canonical mid-route. Open neighbours (18,8)/(19,9), and no shipped save can hold seal_descent_agreed, so the new blocker strands nothing. Bilocation with the Guild-steps Pisces is the shipped pisces_mounting precedent: different maps, never on screen together.
entities.observe: He has not sat down since you got here. One hand hovers a finger's width off the stone, tracking something along it that nobody else in the hall can see, and his lips move without sound.

dialogue.speaker: Pisces
dialogue.text: Quiet, for a moment. I am tracing a line I cannot see. If I lose it I will blame you, and we will both know I am lying.

entities._comment: respawns:true (dormant until the next sleep, the rock_crab_nest/kingslayer_den mechanism).
entities.gate_closed_toast: Rubble and old wardwork still choke this side passage. It can wait until the main halls are clear.
entities.observe: A narrower passage breaks off from the gauntlet proper, half-choked with fallen stone. Small shapes move in the dark past the rubble — more than one.

companion_source.taken_toast: The bones stand joint by joint and follow a pace behind you.

entities.observe: Old bones, dry and disjointed, lying out in the open on bare flagstone.

entities._comment: [Rope Arrow] CARRIER. `gap` + `state_counter` are the table pair; (13,1) opens. The stub never goes absent, which is what lets visual_states SHOW the line -- a state_set the world never shows is invisible durable state.
entities.observe: A stub of masonry where a walkway used to leave this wall, sheared off clean. The other side is still there, four feet out and a long way down. The stub would hold a line all day.
entities.locked_toast: You get a hand on the stub and lean out over the gap — too wide to jump, too smooth to climb, so set a rope here.
entities.anchor_toast: [Rope Arrow] — You make the line fast to the stub, drop the tail across, and set it taut. The line holds your weight and stays where you put it.

entities.observe: The floor is simply gone here, one span of it, edge to edge. Dropped stone comes back as a sound and not much of one.
entities.locked_toast: The floor stops dead and starts again a span out, the dark going down between. No rope goes anywhere from this lip — the line runs from the stub of the broken span.

entities._comment: [Greater Strength] carrier. on_skill_use has NO remove_entity verb (dialogue-side only), so permanence is present_when.absent on the arm's own monotone counter.
entities.observe: One slab off the ceiling, come down whole and standing on its edge across the gap in the wall. Its own weight is the only thing holding it there.
entities.locked_toast: You get both hands under the edge and pull until your eyes swim. It rocks an inch and settles back. Heavier than you.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Hauling at it idly will not do it. Setting your shoulder to it properly might.

on_skill_use.toast: [Greater Strength] — You set your shoulder low, take the whole weight on your legs, and walk it aside. Stone grinds on stone and the gallery mouth stands open behind it.

entities._comment: Gallery payoff; one-shot via present_when.absent on its own counter.
entities.observe: A strapped case set down against the wall and never picked up again, the leather gone stiff and pale.
entities.toast: The straps give at a pull. Inside: chalk, a bent square, a coil of good wire, and five gold in a twist of cloth.

entities._comment: #398-P3 review M7: warded_side_vault_open is in the absent set, so a dual-kit player who prys first finds no tell and no release -- you cannot disarm a sprung snare.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Trace the wire with [Find Trap], then finish the mechanism with [Disarm Trap]. [Greater Strength] could pry the other plate loose instead.
entities.locked_toast: The wire vanishes into a warded floor plate. [Find Trap] and [Disarm Trap] could quiet it; [Greater Strength] could pry the other plate loose.

on_skill_use.toast: [Find Trap] — The wire doubles back beneath the warded plate. Its release sits one finger-width inside the seam.

entities.skill_hint_toast: [Disarm Trap] can still the release you found. [Greater Strength] could pry the other plate loose instead.
entities.locked_toast: You found the release but cannot still it. [Disarm Trap] could clear the snare, or [Greater Strength] could pry the other plate loose.

on_skill_use._comment: String|Array: the mode's own counter plus the shared pocket-open counter the guard's encounter_when reads. encounter_when has no OR arm (review B1).
on_skill_use.toast: [Disarm Trap] — You ease the wire off the catch and pin the spring shut. The vault entrance lies clear.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Set [Greater Strength] under the plate and pry. [Find Trap] and [Disarm Trap] could quiet the snare beside it instead.
entities.locked_toast: The warded plate is pinned hard into the floor. [Greater Strength] could pry it loose; [Find Trap] and [Disarm Trap] could quiet the snare beside it.

on_skill_use.toast: [Greater Strength] — You pry the plate free. The snare lashes against the wall, and the strike rings down the halls.

entities._comment: present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters, so it stands visible and inert from first arrival (rift_vermin_leak's pattern) and counts in every sprite pin. encounter_when is the belt to the wall's braces.
entities.observe: A narrow construct stands over the inner cache. Its ward-lines face the cleared plates behind you, and nothing else opens onto this pocket.
Fine ward-lines leave the cache and run east toward the sealed rune-door deeper in the halls.
entities.toast: The cache opens on a released catch. A lead counterweight rests inside, still holding a quiet ward.
